$Comment: The Golden Turkey Trophy, the Great Turkey's rarest find: a small roll in its Boss Kill Claim on every win in the Turkey Graveyard, rolled again in its daily Claim on the first win each day, three times as likely on the hard way in (ZiggfreedCommon/Lootables/SeasonsOfOrbis/Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Chase.json and its _Hard twin), and nothing sells it. The Turkey Trophy (Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Trophy.json beside this file) in gold: the same block on the game's turkey model, wearing the game's turkey texture recoloured gold by its own shading, and an icon of the game's turkey portrait in the same gold, both written by tools/derive_art.py (an item's Icon must sit under Icons/ItemsGenerated/ or Icons/Items/). CustomModelScale shrinks the creature to about one block high, and the game's Kweebec_Ancient block is the pattern for a creature model placed as a block.
